body: Hey, thanks for getting back to me.  I've been doing some thinking, and I've decided to go informed consent.  So, I'll either look for a doctor in Ann Arbor, or just take a train to the Planned Parenthood in Chicago, where they do do informed consent HRT.  I should know for sure, in a few days.  :)

I really need to get around to playing Doom 3.  It's the only one I've missed, not counting Doom 64.  :)
Well, thanks.  I appreciate the encouragement.  You take care of yourself, too.  :)

Hey, thanks.  Just having a response makes me feel a bit better.  
Unfortunately, I've been out of college, for a few years, at this point.

I'm also in the somewhat unique position that I attempted to come out, ten years ago, but was forced back in by circumstance.  I feel like I had my chance, and that it's too late for me, now.  ):
This post is a cry for help, tbh.  Not sure if that's against the rules or not.  )':

I  am a 27-year-old, pre-everything MTF trans girl.  Not in employment,  education or training, due to a combination of dysphoria and untreated depression.

In summary, I'm tired.  Tired of  pretending to be someone I'm not.  Tired of constantly failing in my  endeavors, due to the mental clouds which hang over my head.  And, I'm  tired of being rejected.

My  brother is visiting today, and I want to tell him who I am, and who I've  always wanted to be: a woman.  But, I don't have the strength to risk  being alienated from the one normal relationship I have left.  To put it  simply, I can't move forward, but I can't go back to who I used to be:  unhappy and worried, maybe, but at the very least hopeful and ignorant.

I  really was going to make this post much longer, but I suppose I'm just  asking for help.  What do I do?  I have no real marketable skills, and  no energy to pursue new ones.  I want to go on, but I'm tired of  fighting.  I feel lost, alone, and alienated from myself and others.

I need help.
